RETURNS numeric AS $$
DECLARE
    v_ors numeric;
    v_tie numeric;
    v_lssr numeric;
BEGIN
    -- Calculate ORS from OperationMaintenance and CabinEnvironment
    SELECT INTO v_ors
        CASE 
            WHEN ce.cabin_env_snapshot->>'emergency' = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - COALESCE(om."OPER_hours", 0) / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs", 0))
            WHEN ce.cabin_env_snapshot->>'emergency' = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - COALESCE(om."OPER_hours", 0) / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs", 0))
            ELSE 0
        END
    FROM "OperationMaintenance" om
    JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce ON om."equipRef" = ce."equipRef"
    WHERE om."equipRef" = p_equip_code
    LIMIT 1;
    
    -- Calculate TIE from ThermalSolarWindAndGrid via Communication link
    SELECT INTO v_tie
        CASE 
            WHEN t."insulationStat" = 'Good' THEN 0.9 - COALESCE(t."heatLoss_kwh", 0) / 10.0
            WHEN t."insulationStat" = 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - COALESCE(t."heatLoss_kwh", 0) / 10.0
            WHEN t."insulationStat" = 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - COALESCE(t."heatLoss_kwh", 0) / 10.0
            ELSE 0
        END
    FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t
    LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON t."comm_link" = c."COMM_ID"
    LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce2 ON c."COMM_ID" = ce2."comm_link"

    -- Calculate LSSR with NULL-safe defaults

    RETURN ROUND(CAST(v_lssr AS numeric), 4);
END;
